Miss International Queen Vietnam 2018, the 1st Miss International Queen Vietnam pageant, was held on January 11, 2019 at Tân Bình Stadium, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam. Persident of Miss International Queen Ms.Alisa Phanthusak crowned her successor Đỗ Nhật Hà of Ho Chi Minh City at the end of the event.
